title: Auditable repair of identity leakage in group-structured data
description: Code, simulation manifests and figure generators for the manuscript 'An auditable instrument for identity leakage in group-structured data: the sibling-unit trap, decision boundaries, and validation in spatial transcriptomics'. Contains the cohort simulator, the label-dependence audit (LDI, tau_LOO / tau_LGO / tau_LDO, block permutation with B = 2000 and seed 20261010), the cross-domain runner, the unit-resolution ladder and the within-group-label control, together with every script that regenerates the reported tables and figures from public data.
